title: Ramp
text: Generate signal that follows input value bound by rising or falling slope, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Sample period; {Rise slope} sets the increase value, {Fall slope} sets the decrease value, {Show reset port} sets the option to add R input port and {Initial condition} sets the initial value of output signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rise slope
params.values: Increase value of output Dialog | Input port

params.name: Show reset port
params.values: Option to add R input port ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial value of output signal 0 (default) | double
